lines.text: John sees four angels holding back the four winds, and an angel from the east carries the seal of the living God.
John hears that 144,000 were sealed from all the tribes of Israel, with 12,000 from each tribe named.
John sees a multitude too large to count, wearing white robes and holding olive branches, crying out salvation to God and the Lamb.
All the angels fall facedown and worship God, and an elder says the people in white robes came out of slavery in Egypt.
The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd and lead them to springs of living water.
